title: Philosophy
description: An offensive football philosophy (West Coast, Air Raid, Power Run, etc.) capturing origins, typical run/pass balance, and what formations and concepts it prefers.

philosophy_id.description: Stable identifier (kebab-case). Must match the filename (without .yaml).

description.description: 2-5 sentence description of the philosophy — core principles, how it uses the run/pass, historical context.

era.description: Approximate time span when the philosophy was/is prominent (e.g. '1979–present', 'Mid-1990s–present').

originators.description: Coaches credited with originating or defining the system. Include team and year range where known.

notable_practitioners.description: Coaches who carried the system forward. Include team and year range where known.

canonical_run_concepts.description: Foreign keys into data/concepts/run-concepts/ — the run concepts most associated with this philosophy.

canonical_pass_concepts.description: Foreign keys into data/concepts/pass-concepts/ — the pass concepts most associated with this philosophy.

formation_preferences.description: Formation IDs or formation-family names most commonly used (e.g. 'i-formation', 'shotgun-2x2').

tendency_profile.description: Approximate play-type distribution. The 5 values must sum to 1.0 (±0.02).
